newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 14.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Feb 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:

* On Thursday, the Dow ended up 60.81 points, or 0.87 percent, at an all-time high of 7,022.44, beating the previous record set just Wednesday. The stock market rode a wave of investor confidence based on low interest rates and non-inflationary economic growth.

* On Wednesday, Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said the appreciation of the dollar over the Japanese yen gave a positive impact to the national economy as it lowered Indonesia's foreign debt and boosted Indonesia's performance in international trade.

* Tambang Timah on expectations the company might be involved in the Busang gold project. Bre-X Minerals Ltd has said the Indonesian government had given the company and Barrick Gold Corp until Feb 14 to settle with their local partners over the huge gold property.
* Blue chip Bank Negara Indonesia on market speculation the Morgan Stanley Capital Index would include the bank in its index this month.
* Lippo Bank on news its floating rate certificates of deposit issue has been increased to US$60 million from US$50 million due to oversubscription.
* Toll road builder and operator Citra Marga on news that its unit had issued a US$125 million bond.
* Bank Danamon on market speculation of a possible acquisition of privately-owned Bank Pacific.
* Pharmaceutical firm Kalbe Farma following its announcement to sell a 50.21-percent stake in subsidiary PT Avesta Continental Pack to PT Igar Jaya.
* Secondary salt producer Fiskaragung on news the company expected to book a net profit of 104 billion rupiah in 1997, compared with unaudited net of 82 billion rupiah in 1996.
* Cocoa manufacturer Davomas Abadi on market expectation of a possible higher net profit in 1996.
* Retailer Matahari Putra Prima on news it had revised up its 1997 net profit target to 91 billion rupiah from 83 billion rupiah.
